subject.title: feat(agents): configured agent env reaches spawned subprocesses

question: Should OpenClaw accept broad literal `agents.list[].env` for CLI, gateway exec, ACP/ACPX, and stdio MCP child processes, or prefer the narrower exec-only SecretRef direction in #96309?
rationale: Both designs affect credential propagation and public config/API shape, and repository policy treats config/env and security-boundary expansion as maintainer-owned product decisions rather than automation-only fixes.

options.title: Accept broad agent env
options.body: Approve this PR's public `agents.list[].env` contract after resolving failing gates and documenting the security boundary.

options.title: Converge on exec-only SecretRef
options.body: Pause this PR and use #96309 or a similar narrower design if maintainers want secrets scoped only to gateway exec.

options.title: Keep env out of core
options.body: Close the PR and keep the workaround/plugin-specific approaches if the public config surface is too broad for core.

recommendation.title: Accept broad agent env
recommendation.body: Approve this PR's public `agents.list[].env` contract after resolving failing gates and documenting the security boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The earlier PR close requirements and recent config/exec history make this the best available owner for the config/env contract decision.
